descriptions.w3d_turns_apply_named_scene_value: Applies a nonempty shared string through the scene service.
descriptions.w3d_turns_select_near_message_position: Posts the nearest active worm to a message position, excluding the selected worm.
descriptions.w3d_turns_record_message_position: Stores a message position and increments the position update count.
descriptions.w3d_turns_select_nearest_opponent: Posts the nearest active worm belonging to a different team.
descriptions.w3d_turns_disable_movement_retain: Increments the movement-disable reference value and returns its previous value.
descriptions.w3d_turns_disable_movement_release: Decrements a nonzero movement-disable reference value and returns its previous value.
descriptions.w3d_turns_team_list_size: Returns the number of worms in a team list when the team index is valid.
descriptions.w3d_turns_reset_global_actor_motion: Resets actor motion through the global turn service when it exists and returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_turns_reset_actor_motion: Resolves sixteen actor handles and resets motion for each resolved actor.
